shared_elements: low relief carving of animals in profile
register-like horizontal bands of repeated motifs
animals shown walking or standing on a groundline
repeated ornamental band along one edge
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief animals in profile arranged in horizontal registers with a repeated band of motifs along an edge, which is a generic organizing convention rather than a shared specific iconography. A shows a naturalistic narrative procession of human attendants leading detailed horned rams past a tree, while B shows highly schematic predatory beasts, birds and a crouching quadruped with a row of frontal animal heads and no humans, so the specific subjects, postures and rendering conventions differ substantially.
